briefdescription.para: Implementation of persistent workspace state management with checksum validation.

detaileddescription.para:
Provides:
SHA-256 checksum validation on state load
Atomic write-replace semantics (write temp, rename on success)
Append-only transaction log for recovery
JSON serialization/deserialization with nlohmann/json

sect2.title: Recovery Strategy
sect2.para:
On load, if state.json is corrupted (checksum mismatch):
Attempt to read from append-only state.log
Reconstruct state from last valid entry
Return reconstructed state with CorruptState code (for logging)

sect2.title: Thread-Safety
sect2.para: Methods are NOT thread-safe. Caller must serialize access via mutex.
